# manuscript_requirements.json reference

`paperpush/manuscript_requirements.json` records what each venue's **author
guidelines** require of the manuscript itself -- the companion to
`venues.json`, which describes the submission form. `paperpush validate`
measures the uploaded files against these rules and `paperpush requirements
VENUE` prints them. The top-level object maps a venue slug to a venue entry;
the special keys `$schema` and `$aliases` are metadata (see below). This page
is generated from `paperpush/manuscript_requirements.schema.json`, which is
itself generated from the dataclasses in `paperpush/requirements.py`.

Every key is optional: an entry records only what the guidelines state, and
rules with no structured key go in a section's `notes` list. Two mechanisms
keep entries short: `inherits` starts from another venue's entry and overrides
keys section by section (a key set to `null` drops the inherited value;
`notes` accumulate), and `article_types` holds per-article-type overrides
keyed by the exact option string of the field named in `article_type_field`.

## Venue entry

The keys of one venue entry. Each section key holds the object described in its own table below.

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `source_urls` | list of string | Guideline pages the entry was taken from. |
| `retrieved` | string | Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the guidelines were last read. |
| `inherits` | string | Slug whose requirements this entry starts from. Empty for a standalone entry. |
| `article_type_field` | string | Id of the .sub field whose value selects an `article_types` override. |
| `article_types` | map of [rules](#rules) | Per-article-type overrides, keyed by the exact option string; each value carries the same section keys as the top level. |
| `manuscript` | [manuscript](#manuscript) or null | Rules for the main manuscript file: format, size, length, and layout. |
| `title_page` | [title_page](#title_page) or null | What the title page must carry. |
| `abstract` | [abstract](#abstract) or null | Abstract length and structure. |
| `keywords` | [keywords](#keywords) or null | How many keywords the manuscript must list. |
| `sections` | [sections](#sections) or null | Section headings the manuscript body must (or may) carry. |
| `statements` | [statements](#statements) or null | Declarations that must appear in the manuscript text. |
| `figures` | [figures](#figures) or null | Figure file format, resolution, dimensions, and count. |
| `tables` | [tables](#tables) or null | Table file format, editability, count, and placement. |
| `supplementary` | [supplementary](#supplementary) or null | Supplementary-file format, size, count, and bundling. |
| `references` | [references](#references) or null | Reference style and count. |
| `cover_letter` | [cover_letter](#cover_letter) or null | Whether a cover letter is required and how it is supplied. |
| `upload` | [upload](#upload) or null | Size caps on the submission's uploads as a whole. |
| `notes` | list of string | Venue-wide rules that fit no section. |

## rules

Per-article-type overrides: the same section keys as a venue entry.

The same section keys as a venue entry (plus `notes`); used as the value of each `article_types` entry.

## manuscript

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `formats` | list of string or null | File extensions accepted for the main manuscript upload (lowercase, with dot). |
| `max_file_size_mb` | number or null | Maximum size of the manuscript file in MB. |
| `max_words` | integer or null | Maximum word count of the whole document, references included. |
| `max_words_before_refs` | integer or null | Maximum word count of the main text (before the reference list). |
| `max_pages` | integer or null | Maximum page count of the whole document. |
| `max_pages_before_refs` | integer or null | Maximum page count of the main text (before the reference list). |
| `main_text_end_headings` | list of string or null | Headings other than the reference list that end the main text for the before-refs limits (e.g. Appendix). |
| `count_excludes` | list of string or null | Parts of the manuscript the venue leaves out of its word/page count (informational). |
| `count_includes` | list of string or null | Parts the venue explicitly counts that authors might not expect (informational). |
| `max_display_items` | integer or null | Maximum number of figures and tables combined. |
| `line_numbers` | boolean or null | Continuous line numbers required. |
| `double_spacing` | boolean or null | Double line spacing required. |
| `page_numbers` | boolean or null | Page numbers required. |
| `font` | string or null | Mandated body font, if any. |
| `font_size_pt` | number or null | Mandated body font size in points, if any. |
| `margins_mm` | number or null | Mandated page margins in mm, if any. |
| `page_size` | string or null | Mandated page size (A4, US Letter), if any. |
| `single_file` | boolean or null | Manuscript must be a single file holding text, figures, and tables. |
| `figures_placement` | `end` \| `inline` \| `separate` \| `end_or_inline` or null | Where figures go relative to the main manuscript file. |
| `tables_placement` | `end` \| `inline` \| `separate` \| `end_or_inline` or null | Where tables go relative to the main manuscript file. |
| `anonymized` | boolean or null | Double-blind: no author names or affiliations in the manuscript. |
| `template_required` | boolean or null | Must use the venue's style file or template. |
| `template_url` | string or null | URL of the venue's template. |
| `latex_class` | string or null | Required LaTeX document class or style file. |
| `language` | string or null | Mandated language variant, if any. |
| `notes` | list of string or null | Rules with no structured key, one per string. |

## $aliases

Heading wordings that count as each canonical section / statement name when the manuscript text is searched. Keys: sections, statements; each maps a canonical name to a list of alternative headings.

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sections` | map of list of string |  |
| `statements` | map of list of string |  |
